info.name: Course API
info.description: Course API requests (Week 1 + Week 2). Select the "Local" environment and run the folders in order: requests save taskId, linkedTaskId and projectId for later requests. Set loadTestId to the project id printed by `node scripts/seed-tasks.js` before running "List queries". The Auth folder registers a new fictional user (user.<timestamp>@example.com) on each run and saves the issued JWT as token.

exec: pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Route GET /api/v1/unknown not found"); });

pm.test("Course API project exists", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.projects.find((x) => x.name === "Course API"); pm.expect(p).to.be.an("object"); pm.environment.set("projectId", p._id); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A record with that name already exists"); });
pm.test("Field error message", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors[0].message).to.eql("Name must be at most 80 characters"); });
pm.test("Defaults applied", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("todo"); pm.expect(d.priority).to.eql("high"); pm.environment.set("taskId", d._id); });
pm.test("Project is populated", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.project.name).to.eql("Course API"); pm.environment.set("linkedTaskId", d._id); });
pm.test("Pagination present", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.pagination; pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.limit).to.eql(10); });
pm.test("Every task is done", () => { pm.response.json().data.tasks.forEach((t) => pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("done")); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid value for project: abc"); });
pm.test("Project name and description", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.project; pm.expect(p.name).to.eql("Course API"); pm.expect(p.description).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Updated document returned; createdAt unchanged", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("done"); pm.expect(d.createdAt.startsWith("2000")).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("total 120, totalPages 12", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.pagination; pm.expect(p.total).to.eql(120); pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.eql(12); });

pm.test("count 5, total 40, totalPages 8, starts at 016", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(5); pm.expect(d.pagination.total).to.eql(40); pm.expect(d.pagination.totalPages).to.eql(8); pm.expect(d.tasks[0].title).to.eql("Sample task 016"); });
pm.test("Latest due dates first", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.tasks.map((t) => t.title)).to.eql(["Sample task 120", "Sample task 119", "Sample task 118"]); });
pm.test("Empty page", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.tasks).to.eql([]); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Cannot sort by \"priority\". Use: dueDate, createdAt, title"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("page must be a positive whole number"); });
pm.test("Name trimmed, email normalised", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Asha"); pm.expect(d.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get("authEmail")); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("A record with that email already exists"); });

pm.test("One error per field", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map((e) => e.message)).to.eql(["Name is required", "Email must be a valid email address", "Password must be at least 8 characters"]); });
pm.test("72-byte message", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors[0].message).to.eql("Password must be at most 72 bytes"); });

pm.test("User returned without password", () => { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get("authEmail")); pm.expect(pm.response.text().includes("password")).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("Token is a JWT for this user, valid for 1 hour", () => { const decode = (part) => JSON.parse(atob(part.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"))); const d = pm.response.json().data; const parts = d.token.split("."); pm.expect(parts.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(decode(parts[0]).alg).to.eql("HS256"); const p = decode(parts[1]); pm.expect(p.sub).to.eql(d.user._id); pm.expect(p.exp - p.iat).to.eql(3600); pm.environment.set("token", d.token); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password"); });
pm.test("Message is correct", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password"); });
